TURF 235.name: The Turfgrass
TURF 235.description: Characterization of the primary plant species used for sports, lawn, and utility turf.

TURF 230.name: Turfgrass Pesticides
TURF 230.description: Chemical toxicity, formulations, environmental fate, labels, and Pennsylvania certification requirements.

TURF 238.name: Turf and Ornamental Weed Control
TURF 238.description: Introduction to the development of integrated weed management strategies. Cross-listed with HORT 238.

TURF 307.name: Golf Course Irrigation and Drainage
TURF 307.description: Irrigation management and drainage systems for turfgrass applications. MATH 21 and SOILS 101 recommended (not enforced).

TURF 425.name: Turfgrass Cultural Systems
TURF 425.description: Integration of maintenance practices for golf, sports, and home lawn turfgrass. SOILS 101 recommended (not enforced).

TURF 434.name: Turfgrass Edaphology
TURF 434.description: Soil physical properties interpretation using USGA specifications. SOILS 101 recommended (not enforced).

TURF 435.name: Turfgrass Nutrition
TURF 435.description: Soil chemical properties and nutrient management strategies with substantial laboratory work. SOILS 101 recommended (not enforced).

TURF 436W.name: Case Studies in Turfgrass Management
TURF 436W.description: Writing-intensive capstone course using real-life turfgrass problem scenarios. TURF 238 and TURF 425 recommended (not enforced).

TURF 490.name: Colloquium
TURF 490.description: Student-developed oral presentations. Bulletin requires 7th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.
